subject: Request: Short-term invoice-only route for MicroTransact trial
messages:
From: Sara Jacobson <sara@microtransact.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@microtransact.com
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Quick ask — trial onboarding and PO requirement

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at MicroTransact is excited to run a short pilot integrating Redwood's inference API for our fraud-scoring flows. Procurement at our side has a PO-first rule, but because this is a 30–45 day technical pilot with a $3k expected spend, our legal and finance leads asked whether Redwood supports an "invoice-only" intake for short pilots.

Two asks from our side: can Redwood provision an invoice-only vendor path for small pilots (no PO required) on a timebox (e.g., 60–90 days)? And if yes, what controls do you require so your finance team is comfortable with exceptions? We can provide a W9 and a single-point billing contact.

Attaching the W9 and a brief pilot SOW as separate docs (attached). Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Sara Jacobson
Head of Integrations, MicroTransact
[sent with attachment: MicroTransact_W9.pdf]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Jacobson <sara@microtransact.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick ask — trial onboarding and PO requirement

Hi Sara — thanks for the note and for sending the W9. Quick answer: we can consider a limited invoice-only path for short technical pilots, provided we put a few guardrails in place.

Proposed controls for a 60–90 day pilot:
- Spend cap: $5,000 total (pre-agreed)
- Net terms: 30/45 days depending on account status
- Evidence: sample prompts and an initial quality sign-off so we can monitor usage and cost drift
- Legal: limited addendum (one paragraph) confirming pilot scope and data handling (we can reuse our standard pilot addendum)
- Accounting: single billing contact and tax ID required

If Finance approves, we can set MicroTransact as an "invoice-only" vendor for 90 days and require review before any extension. I attached the pilot-evidence-template we use internally to collect the usage/eval checklist — please fill that out and return.

Next steps I propose:
1) Sara: confirm billing contact and provide tax ID (or attach vendor_taxid.pdf)
2) Priyom: run the onboarding checklist & confirm any operational blockers
3) Rishi: confirm finance OK and the temporary vendor setup process

I copied Rishi and Priyom to keep procurement and finance in the loop. If the three of us sign off, I'll route the onboarding form and lock the temporary invoice-only status. Can you do a quick sync on Wednesday morning?

Thanks — Marissa
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
[sent with attachment: pilot-evidence-template.xlsx]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Jacobson <sara@microtransact.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick ask — trial onboarding and PO requirement

Marissa / Priyom / Sara — quick finance read: I'm comfortable with a conditional invoice-only exception for the pilot with these explicit controls:
- Invoice cap set at $5,000; any spend beyond that requires a PO or formal contract amendment
- Payment terms: Net 45 for first invoice; we can move to Net 30 after account review
- Require MicroTransact to sign our pilot addendum and confirm data handling + liability limits (legal to sign off but low-risk wording)
- Accounting needs vendor tax ID (EIN) and billing email to create vendor record

Operational asks: please add a billing code (GL) request in the onboarding form so AP can route invoices correctly. Also, provide a primary billing contact and expected billing cadence (monthly or one-off).

I'll flag this to Payments to expedite vendor creation once we have the W9/EIN. Drive folder with the temporary approval template is here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0A1-MicroTransact-Docs

-Rishi
Head of Finance Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Sara Jacobson <sara@microtransact.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@microtransact.com, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick ask — trial onboarding and PO requirement

Thanks Rishi and Marissa — appreciate the quick turnaround. Attached is MicroTransact's EIN and vendor form (vendor_taxid.pdf). Billing contact will be:
- Name: Nina Patel
- Email: nina.patel@microtransact.com
- Phone: +1 415 555 0199

We expect the pilot to generate 2–3 invoices total (one at kick-off for prepay if needed, then one final) and will stay under $4k based on our usage estimate.

I can join Wednesday morning; propose 9:30am PT.

Best,
Sara
[sent with attachment: vendor_taxid.pdf]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Jacobson <sara@microtransact.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 7 Dec 2026 16:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick ask — trial onboarding and PO requirement

All — confirming next steps and approval path so we have a written record:

1) Finance (Rishi) has provisionally approved a 90-day invoice-only vendor path for MicroTransact with a $5k cap and Net 45 terms for the first invoice. Extension requires review.
2) Legal will issue a one-paragraph pilot addendum (I will attach and route) — Sara to confirm acceptance.
3) Priyom to complete the onboarding checklist and create the vendor record in our AP system using the attached EIN and contact.
4) Marissa will submit the final onboarding form and tag the Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0A1-MicroTransact-Docs

Attachments we have on file: MicroTransact_W9.pdf, vendor_taxid.pdf, pilot-evidence-template.xlsx

Priyom — can you confirm by end of day tomorrow that vendor is created as "Invoice-only (90d trial)" and that AP has the GL code in place? Sara — once you accept the pilot addendum, we are good to go to start integration.

Thanks everyone — will follow up with the formal onboarding packet after legal finalizes the addendum.

Cheers,
Marissa
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
